health.evm.title: Performance Metrics & EVM
health.evm.pvBasisBaseline: Planned value follows the task baselines.
health.evm.pvBasisMixed: Planned value follows baselines where set, current dates elsewhere.
health.evm.pvBasisCurrent: Planned value follows current dates (no baseline set).
health.evm.durationWeightedNote: Without budgets, SPI and progress are duration-weighted.
health.evm.cpiExplain: CPI measures the value of work completed against the actual money spent. A CPI >= 1.0 means the project is running efficiently.
health.evm.criticalExplain: Any delay to a critical task directly pushes out the project completion date. Focus delivery on the critical chain to protect the finish date.
health.evm.healthExplain: Score begins at 100 and drops when SPI or CPI decrease below 1.0 or when open tasks are blocked by unfinished predecessor dependencies.
health.evm.fullAnalysisDesc: Cost and schedule performance indices with a completion forecast, measured on {date}.
health.evm.coverageTitle: Measured on the tasks that report an actualCost ({percent}% of the budget)
health.evm.tcpiSub: Efficiency needed to stay on budget

health.scurve.addCostAfter: to tasks to see planned value, earned value and actual cost over time.
health.scurve.description: The line is the planned budget over time. EV and AC are measured on {date}; past progress is not recorded, so they are shown at that date only.

health.audit.title: Schedule Health (selected DCMA checks)
health.audit.scoreTitle: Health score: 100 minus the points deducted by each failing check (see the score breakdown). Checks are DCMA-inspired; status-date, resource and baseline checks are not assessed.
health.audit.negativeFloatTip: Negative float: a task can only meet the target date if it finishes earlier than currently planned.
health.audit.negativeFloatExplain: Negative float occurs when the forecast finish date of any task on the critical path falls after the project target date specified in plan settings.
health.audit.logicExplain: Tasks without predecessors or successors float independently and will not automatically shift when linked work changes. Link tasks together to preserve schedule integrity.
health.audit.highFloatExplain: High float (more than 44 working days of slack) often suggests an incomplete downstream dependency network or artificial fixed constraints.
health.audit.group.negativeFloat: Tasks finishing after the target date

prompt.ideology.title: Stop Asking AI to Write Fragile Timeline Code
prompt.ideology.bodyBefore: Having LLMs generate hundreds of lines of React JSX, SVG coordinate math, and canvas listeners produces brittle, hallucination-prone results. With Jantt, the AI outputs
prompt.ideology.bodyAfter: , and Jantt delivers deterministic, interactive execution.
prompt.step1.title: Feed the Prompt to an LLM
prompt.step1.body: Give the AI the compact schema contract (WBS, dates, dependencies, milestones, budget).
prompt.step2.title: AI Outputs Plain JSON
prompt.step2.body: Far fewer tokens than UI code, and every field can be checked by the validator.
prompt.step3.title: Instant Interactive Suite
prompt.step3.body: Jantt resolves dependency schedules, routes links, and renders Gantt, Kanban & Analytics.
prompt.step4.title: Round-Trip Editing
prompt.step4.body: Humans drag and adjust visually. Jantt keeps clean JSON in the browser, ready to export back to the AI agent.
